justification: Local execution service is unavailable. Root requested a concrete SOURCE-only Git-first substitute; this package does not itself alter any existing native authorization.
steps: After a separate exact GO is whole-read, initialize the unchanged helper once with its exact pin and root-computed typed digest/fingerprint.
gfPrepareOne creates one immutable three-leaf tree: exact request, intent, armed checkpoint; whole readback completes before any native call.
Return to a model boundary. gfInvokePreparedOnce may enter only the one armed call; called/inflight are recorded synchronously before dispatch.
The returned complete original SDK is immediately retained in V8; SDK JSON is stored in one Git content tree and whole-read before isError or native text interpretation.

gfAcceptArchivedSDK first checks isError and shape, then lossless native fields. Start binds the original mac job/digest/uint64 fingerprint; subsequent native tools are limited to process_status/process_read on this job or status/result on the active original operation_id.
Every status/page call has its own external exact request+intent+armed checkpoint and SDK whole readback. There is no automatic native retry or multi-call loop.
Complete original operation payload is reassembled by consecutive offsets, immutable total/SHA and EOF; stored whole in Git; original native response is inspected only afterward.

The contained native text has a derived pin. That pin is not claimed as an independently created blob until the final observer packet writes it. Its exact bytes already reside in the whole original payload.
Only after original payload/native success and same job/cursor checks is that observer cleared and the next observer allowed.
Git uncertainty stops the line. gfReconcileSameGitArchiveReadOnly fetches only original expected immutable tree/blobs and preserves SDKs; it never mutates, dispatches, unpauses, or grants retry.
Cache loss or lost native ACK requires restoring the external armed record/SDK and root-directed original-ID reconciliation. Never initialize a clean context to erase an earlier call.
callsAllowedByHelper: operation_start process_status for actual bound original job
operation_start process_read with actual next stdout/stderr cursors, limit16384
operation_result actual closed/inactive operation_id, exact next offset, limit8192
originalCallSourceBoundary: No native function was invoked while constructing, syntax-checking or archiving this helper.

pureChecks.scope: JS syntax compilation and four cached-schema/arithmetic checks; not a native dispatch or product test

limitations: V8 store is volatile. External armed/SDK objects remain the durable record. Transport loss before SDK retention leaves UNKNOWN.

Git GET wrappers are retained as complete serialized SDKs under the pure_git_once key before interpretation. They must be included in the final archival companion rather than claiming volatile store alone is durable.
The existing pure helper's processStartBinding is not used; it is not qualified for this typed request. Root supplies the actual digest/fingerprint.
This is a proposed journaling exception and bounded call wrapper, not a source of authorization or evidence of old registration cleanup.
